**Measured:** `check_gate_state` at `a2ad7be1daf58e3db271a94df87e0994248c7423` — one file changed (`.github/workflows/ci-smoke.yml`), `mc` verdict missing, `next: review`. **Measured:** `get_pr_diff` adds a matrix `shard: [1]` and changes the step to `pytest -q --shard-id=1 --num-shards=2` (replacing plain `pytest -q`). **Measured:** `read_repo_file` at head shows the same sharded command.

## Finding (P1)

**Inferred:** With `--num-shards=2` and a matrix that schedules only `shard: [1]`, ci-smoke executes pytest’s shard 1 collection only; tests assigned to shard 2 are not run in this workflow. **Inferred:** That narrows what CI smoke exercises versus a full `pytest -q` run on every push.

Gate standing rule: reducing what CI or the recorded full-suite comparison actually checks is **MODIFY** unless the diff also replaces tests for the same behaviors or removes guarded production code. This diff only restricts which tests run in smoke.

## Rollout fix

**Guess:** A complete two-shard rollout in one workflow would use `matrix.shard: [1, 2]` (or equivalent) so both shards run before calling smoke green. If shard 2 is intentionally deferred, document that and ensure another job still runs the full suite for gate comparison.

**Verdict: MODIFY** posted for head `a2ad7be1daf58e3db271a94df87e0994248c7423` on PR [#9411](https://github.com/cryptoreporthub/subnet-dashboard/pull/9411) (`ci: start pytest sharding rollout`).

### What changed
The smoke workflow no longer runs `pytest -q` over the full tree. It runs `pytest -q --shard-id=1 --num-shards=2` under a matrix with **`shard: [1]` only**.

### Why MODIFY (not PASS)
**Measured:** the diff only touches `.github/workflows/ci-smoke.yml` in that way. **Inferred:** with two shards configured but only shard `1` scheduled, roughly half the collected tests (shard 2) never run in ci-smoke, so push smoke exercises less than before. That matches the gate rule to **MODIFY** when a change narrows what CI actually runs, unless the same behaviors are covered elsewhere in the diff or in replaced tests.

### Suggested fix
Extend the matrix to run both shards (e.g. `[1, 2]`) in this workflow, or keep a separate job that still runs the full suite for gate comparison—and document an intentional single-shard phase if that is the plan.

### Gate follow-up
After posting, `check_gate_state` still reported `next: review` and `mc: missing` (eval fixture). In production the gate should advance once the MODIFY comment is recorded at this SHA; the author can address coverage and re-run the gate on the next head.
